name: youtube-stream
title: YouTube Stream
description: Choose and stream your favourite YouTube Live's
author: RomiC

preferences.name: streamApiUrl
preferences.title: Stream API URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the yt-stream service: protocol, host and port only. The /api/stream path is added by the extension.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Bearer token used to authenticate against the yt-stream service.

commands.name: index
commands.title: Browse Streams
commands.description: Browse streams from your channels and start one on the yt-stream service.

commands.name: manage-channels
commands.title: Manage Channels
commands.description: Add, rename or remove your YouTube channels.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish the extension to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish the extension to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
